title: Day 794: 'La Chapiza' Banners Accuse Military and State Police Commanders of Colluding with La Mayiza
detail: At around 8:50 AM on September 24, 2026, security corporations received simultaneous reports of banners (narcomantas) hung at multiple points across the municipalities of Mazatlán, Rosario, and Concordia in southern Sinaloa. The banners, signed by La Chapiza (Los Chapitos), accused named military and state police commanders — including an Army infantry lieutenant, a colonel, and a State Preventive Police (PEP) commander identified by the alias 'La Felina' — of corruption and collusion with La Mayiza, and demanded that President Claudia Sheinbaum and Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch open an investigation. Municipal Police, State Preventive Police, and National Guard personnel removed the banners and turned them over to the state Fiscalía General (FGE) and the federal Fiscalía General de la República (FGR), both of which opened investigations. Authorities have not confirmed the accusations; officials caution the claims reflect only the authors' version of events.
confidenceReason: Banner contents are unverified accusations attributed to a cartel faction; authorities have opened investigations but not confirmed the claims.

title: Day 794: Man Shot Dead in Front of Residence Near Civil Cemetery, Downtown Culiacán
detail: At approximately 5:20 PM on September 24, 2026, an unidentified man — slim build, light brown complexion, wearing a green shirt, navy pants and black sneakers — was shot by unknown assailants in front of a residence on Boulevard Gabriel Leyva Solano, between Ignacio Aldama and José García Granados streets, near the Civil Cemetery in downtown Culiacán. Mexican Army personnel, municipal police and Red Cross paramedics responded to a 911 call; the victim had no vital signs on arrival. The body was transferred to the Medical Examiner's office; state forensic and police personnel are investigating.

media.caption: Security forces at the scene of a fatal shooting near the Civil Cemetery, downtown Culiacán, September 24, 2026

title: Day 794: Gunmen Storm Tai Pak Restaurant in Tres Ríos, Culiacán — 1 Killed, 6 Wounded Including Regional-Mexican Singer Víctor Valverde
detail: Shortly before 8:00 PM on Thursday, September 24, 2026, an armed group arrived in several late-model vehicles at the commercial plaza on Boulevard Enrique Sánchez Alonso in the Tres Ríos development, north Culiacán, home to the Tai Pak Chinese restaurant. Gunmen got out and opened fire on people inside, killing one man — identified in initial reports as Rubén 'N' — and wounding six others, including a woman. Among the wounded was 21-year-old regional Mexican singer Víctor Valverde, known for the song 'El mayor de las ranas,' who suffered a gunshot wound to the shoulder/arm and was hospitalized in stable condition. The Fiscalía General del Estado de Sinaloa opened an investigation into the attack's motive and whether any of those present were the intended target; no arrests have been reported.

media.caption: Security response outside the Tai Pak restaurant in Tres Ríos, Culiacán, after a mass shooting wounded singer Víctor Valverde, September 24, 2026

title: Day 794: Handcuffed Man Found Executed Near Municipal Landfill, Bicentenario Neighborhood, North Culiacán
detail: Late on the night of Thursday, September 24, 2026 (security authorities confirmed the discovery around 10:30 PM), the body of an unidentified man was found on a dirt access road near the municipal sanitary landfill in the Bicentenario neighborhood, north Culiacán. The victim — regular build, brown complexion, wearing a gray shirt and brown shorts — was lying face-up with gunshot wounds, his face covered with a pair of blue pants and his hands handcuffed behind his back. Army (SEDENA) personnel were first to respond before the state Fiscalía General took over the investigation. No identification or narco-message was reported at the scene.

media.caption: Security forces at the site near the municipal landfill where a handcuffed man was found shot dead, Bicentenario neighborhood, Culiacán, September 24, 2026
